title: The Layers panel menu carries the icon mock's Center on the artboard, Union and Outline stroke rows
goal: The icon drawing mock puts five commands in the Layers panel menu; after Mirror Across Center landed the menu has the first two (Group Selection, Mirror Across Center) but not Center on the artboard, Union or Outline stroke, so someone following the icon walkthrough cannot find them there.
notes: Found while doing mirror-across-center-copies-a-shape-about-the-mi (2026-10-09). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html ~line 491 #layerMenu. Union already exists as right-click Combine Shapes > Join (PathCombining.swift); Outline stroke (stroke to filled path) does not exist anywhere yet. Center on the artboard = align to the containing frame centre both ways; Arrange already aligns in Frame. Rows live in Sources/PhotonzCore/LayersPanelHeader.swift MenuRow + Sources/Photonz/LayersPanelHeaderControls.swift.
acceptance: The Layers panel menu shows Center on the artboard, then a divider, then Union and Outline stroke, below Mirror Across Center, as icon-draw-wt.html #layerMenu draws it
Each row is also in the menu bar and on the shape right-click menu under the same name
Center on the artboard does not take Option Command C (that is Canvas Size, Photoshop parity); it gets a free key or none, and the choice is a decision card if no key fits
A walk at Next defaults runs each row and reads the result

log.note: Adversarial review before building: (1) Union already exists as Combine Shapes > Join, destructive; the mock says Union 'stays live' (sources kept underneath). That live-combine departure was already weighed and settled by two-shapes-become-one-join-them-cut-one-out-keep (its acceptance asked for real anchors), so Union here is Join under the mock's name and key, not a new live boolean. (2) A box or oval's line is a Border effect, not a stroke (OutlineRetirement), and a Union of boxes wears that Border: an Outline Stroke that only read PathContent.strokeWidth would do nothing on the mock's own cloud. So it outlines the shape's own stroke AND every painted Border, matching DocumentRenderer.ringed geometry. (3) A shape with a fill AND a line cannot be one filled path with two paints: the fill stays, the outline goes on a new layer above (Illustrator does the same, as a group); when the shape was see-through or wore effects the pieces are grouped so the group wears the look once. (4) Mock key Option Command C is Canvas Size (Photoshop parity), so Center on the Artboard gets no key, as the acceptance allows. (5) A Photoshop or Figma user expects Union and Outline Stroke under exactly these words (Figma: Union selection, Outline stroke); Center on the artboard maps to Figma's align-to-frame. (6) All three are pictures and icons only (not video), like Mirror beside them.

Audit rough items, none filed: Center key (settled by the Photoshop-parity answer of 2026-07-05), live Union (settled by two-shapes-become-one-join-them-cut-one-out-keep), Title Case (UX-PATTERNS 7), SF glyphs (UX-PATTERNS 8) are settled differences. Left rough, not filed: Union is both its own row (with the mock's key) and Combine Shapes > Join, an overlap asked about in the audit's evaluate list rather than guessed; a drawn box or oval arrives with no line at defaults, so Outline Stroke is dimmed until one is added, which is correct; a thick line on a tiny shape outlines to a solid shape the size of the fill (same picture).

Layers panel menu now has Center on the Artboard, then a divider, Union (Option Command U) and Outline Stroke (Shift Command O), under Mirror Across Center as icon-draw-wt.html draws them; each also in the Layer menu and a shape's right-click menu under the same name (flag next-icon-shape-commands, on in Next). Center has no key since Option Command C is Canvas Size. Core tested first (CenterOnArtboard.swift, OutlineStroke.swift, which outlines a shape's own stroke and its Borders); full suite 12110 tests green. Walks layers-menu-icon-rows-walk and layers-menu-icon-rows-right-click-walk pass at Next defaults with real pictures; audit queue/audits/2026-10-09-layers-menu-icon-rows.json. Commit 621eefd0.
